lastHandoff.summary: Serve 800w WebP variants via srcset with an 830px desktop hero slot.
lastHandoff.reason: Mobile heroes were downloading 1200-1400px covers. 192 nine-hundred-pixel variants (15KB avg) cut the mobile hero from 24.5KB to ~15KB. sizes must describe the real layout width: the article column is 830px on desktop (max-w-6xl 1120 minus 250 sidebar and 40 gap), not the 700px prose width, or the browser upscales a 699px image.

decisions.summary: Use repository-owned project memory before adding Graphiti.
decisions.reason: The repo already contains state.json, Mission Control, SQLite SEO memory, and agent rules; a graph service would add another state store and database dependency before the handoff contract is stable.
Only one article may be made live in a session; all other article work remains draft-only until human review.
